title: Ground units move at full speed across slow terrain (floor speed multipliers ignored)

path.to: campaign/in-engine: control a ground mech (player unit or Dagger) over stone vs deep water and measure per-tick displacement

java: reference Ground Zero (or any map with deep-water/sand-water): move a ground unit onto deep water; per-tick speed drops by Floor.speedMultiplier (deep-water 0.2) via UnitComp.speed()/floorSpeedMultiplier()
flyers/hoovering use Blocks.air (1.0); a possessed flyer additionally gets the strafePenalty lerp
godot: same map in the Godot client or headless unit harness: move the same unit onto deep water; per-tick displacement is unchanged from stone

code: ai/types/ground.rs:113-120 and ai/types/flying.rs:47-58 compute speed as physics.speed * status.speed_multiplier only; ai/types/player.rs:74-77 has the comment that boost/floor/strafe multipliers are not modeled; world::behavior::environment::floor_speed_multiplier has no movement caller (only crawl.rs:87 / tank.rs:95 tread kinematics and water_move tests)
compare: per-tick displacement ratio deep-water/stone should equal pow(Floor.speedMultiplier, type.floorMultiplier) (e.g. 0.2 for a mech); the port shows 1.0

fix.summary: Movement speed ignores the walked floor's speed multiplier, type.floorMultiplier, boost and strafe multipliers.

plan.state: seeded by code-scan 2026-10-10; not yet verified in-engine
plan.seam: client/rust/mind-core/src/ai/ai_controller.rs:54 (AiCtx::pref_speed) plus the per-controller copies in ai/types/ground.rs:113, ai/types/flying.rs:51 and ai/types/player.rs:74
plan.approach: 1) Add one shared `unit_speed(world, grid, content, entity) -> f32` porting UnitComp.speed(): `PhysicsComp.speed` * straight-strafe penalty (only for possessed flyers: lerp(1, type.strafe_penalty, angle_dist(vel.angle(), rotation)/180)) * boost lerp(1, boostMultiplier, elevation) * `pow(floor_meta.speed_multiplier, def.floor_multiplier)` (air/1.0 for flying or hovering) * `StatusComp.speed_multiplier`. 2) Replace the four local speed computations (pref_speed, update_ground, update_flying, update_player) with that call so terrain slows all movement paths. 3) Keep crawl/tank tread slowdown semantics on top (their own floor_speed_multiplier bodies stay). 4) Add a harness test that spawns a Dagger on stone vs on deep-water tiles and asserts the deep-water per-tick displacement is ~0.2x with the status multiplier at 1.
plan.narrow_check: cargo test -p mind-core ai:: (with the new terrain-speed harness test) plus a headless per-tick displacement scenario

note: Code-scan 2026-10-10 (units-ai): S3, high confidence (code reading). Player impact: units cross deep water, ice, sludge and sand-water at full speed instead of the upstream floor-scaled speed, and possessed flyers skip the strafe penalty; terrain-based defences (slow water, drown zones) lose their effect. The helper world::behavior::environment::floor_speed_multiplier:92 exists but no movement path calls it; crawl.rs:87 and tank.rs:95 only scale tread animation. In-engine verification pending.

title: Direct bullet hits pass through units: only splash/EMP/ability damage can kill them

path.to: Ground Zero wave defense: let a wave Dagger stand next to a Duo or another Dagger and fire

java: reference: Logic.update runs Groups.bullet.update() then Groups.bullet.collide() (Logic.java:495-496); the collide pass walks EntityCollisions.checkCollide (EntityCollisions.java:144-167/218-243) and BulletComp.collision (BulletComp.java:124-143) so basic projectiles damage units and notify the unit controller
godot: live runtime: two hostile daggers in weapon range (or a target unit in front of a firing turret) shoot each other indefinitely with both at full health; bullet collision only raycasts tile.build (combat/bullet/mod.rs:724-889 `collide_bullet`), and EntitySet::PhysicsBullets/PhysicsUnits in sim/schedule.rs:427-437 have no registered systems at all

only splash (damage/damage_area hits units), EMP radius, abilities/status DoT and the unit-branch of hit_building (unreachable: hit_building is only ever called with building targets from collide_bullet/point/sap) can reduce unit health
compare: a basic bullet hit on a unit reduces its health (armor-aware) and a dagger dies after the expected number of hits; in the port the unit health never changes

fix.summary: The bullet-vs-unit collision pass (Groups.bullet.collide/EntityCollisions) is missing; collide_bullet handles buildings only.

plan.seam: client/rust/mind-core/src/combat/bullet/mod.rs:724 (`collide_bullet`, buildings-only) plus the empty EntitySet::PhysicsBullets slot in sim/schedule.rs:427-437
plan.approach: 1) Port EntityCollisions.checkCollide for bullets against units: for each live bullet sweep its hitbox (Bullet.hit_size, last -> current position) against hostile units from UnitRuntime.units, honoring BulletType.collidesAir/collidesGround, pierce/collided list, sticky and team rules. 2) On overlap run the same hit pipeline as buildings (`hit_bullet` + behavior_hit + `BulletType.hitEntity`) and apply damage through the armor-aware `damage_entity` (area.rs:207) so unit armor, armor_override and armor_multiplier work (the current hit_building unit branch forces armor 0 at mod.rs:527-531) and fold in the `Rule`/team damage multipliers there. 3) Register the pass in CollideBullets after the tile raycast (or extend bullet_collide_system) and, optionally, port unit-vs-unit push for PhysicsUnits. 4) Record any checksum/golden movement caused by the new collisions. 5) Test: headless dagger-vs-dagger scenario asserts health drops per hit and the unit dies after the expected shot count.
plan.narrow_check: cargo test -p mind-core combat (new bullet_damages_unit test) plus a headless wave-defense scenario where a Duo kills a Dagger

note: Code-scan 2026-10-10 (units-ai): S2, high confidence (code reading). Player impact: units cannot be killed by direct-fire weapons - wave enemies walk through bullet fire unharmed unless the weapon has splash (Scatter/Fuse) or the bullet is laser/EMP/line based (which also only scans buildings via collide_line), so normal wave defense and unit-vs-unit combat are non-functional; unit health can only drop via splash/ability/status. The same gap also means units never take collision damage from each other. In-engine verification pending.
